Hayaki is an unofficial fork of AnkiDroid
Move your Decks from AnkiWeb through AnkiDroid or desktop Anki to keep their scheduling, review history and media.
Sync in AnkiDroid or desktop Anki
This brings in everything from AnkiWeb.
On AnkiDroid, choose Export collection in the Decks menu. On desktop Anki, choose File › Export › Anki Collection Package (.colpkg). Include media.
